revenue.passage: Item 21, Exhibit B, p. B-7, audited Statements of Operations for the franchisor Hounds Town USA, LLC. FY2023 operating revenue was $3,386,658. It comprises $1,384,395 in royalties, $1,532,204 in initial franchise fees, $385,908 in marketing fees, and $84,151 in technology fees.

locations.passage: Item 19 opening paragraph. The full network had 55 open outlets on December 31, 2023, comprising 54 franchised and one affiliate-owned outlet.

additional_claims.passage: Item 19 financial performance representations use an unaudited group of 37 outlets (36 franchised, one affiliate-owned) open for at least 12 months. A franchisee did not provide data for Table 11.
